title: The General Matrix still prices categories with no matrix of their own
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client whose default matrix had rules before the release (for example $24.01 to $55.00 at 150% markup).
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix, so it has no matrix of its own.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the General Matrix's name.
  3. Open Settings › Categories.
  4. Click category A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The General Matrix is listed first.

Step 2:

  • Its grid shows the rules the default matrix had before the release (for example $24.01 to $55.00 at 150% markup).

Step 3:

  • Category A is listed on the General Matrix.

Step 4:

  • Category A's page shows the General Matrix's grid.
